result.rationale: group_member.hbs is rendered per member via `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`, so the template context is the Discourse.User member, not the group. `{{#unless automatic}}` therefore evaluates the User's `automatic` property (undefined/undefined-ish) rather than the group's, so the remove link is always rendered even for automatic groups, where `removeMember` is prohibited (controller returns 422). No controller proxying the group is set up for the view (group-member.js.es6 only sets classNames/templateName), so the mechanism described is correct.
